head: GTA 6 AI photo prompt trend: turn a selfie into a GTA poster in ChatGPT
dek: Since GTA 6 came out, people are turning their selfies into neon Vice City posters with ChatGPT or Gemini and posting them on Instagram; brands use the look too. All it takes is a photo and a prompt.
details: In ChatGPT you tap the plus button, upload a clear, well-lit photo of your face, paste a prompt describing a GTA 6-style poster (Vice City street, palm trees, sunset, outfit) and refine the result. If the face doesn't look like you, ask it to keep the face closer to the original. ChatGPT's free plan allows only a limited number of images, and Gemini is another option.
where: ChatGPT and Gemini, app or website
means: If you want to join the trend, you don't need editing skills, but you do hand a photo of your face to an AI chatbot.
todo: Use a clear photo, ask for small changes one at a time, and check hands and fingers before you post. Think about which photos you're comfortable sharing with a chatbot.
